_comment: Phase 0 artifact and source of truth for a Keynote Deck Builder deck. One slide object per idea. Required per slide: n (1-based), type (TITLE|STATEMENT|WORD|QUESTION|STEP|PIPELINE|TRIAD|CLOSE), and the content fields that type uses (see references/../SLIDE_TYPES.md). Optional everywhere: accent (BLUE|GREEN|GOLD|PINK|VIOLET|SOFT), motif (orbit|ripple|nodes|road|branch|spark|converge|grid|arc|none), notes (speaker script for this beat; baked into PowerPoint notes). No double-quotes inside string values; use single quotes for quoted phrases. Keep on-slide text SHORT — the slide is punctuation behind the spoken line, not a paragraph.

slides.notes: Opening line(s) the speaker says here.

slides.text: The single question that frames the talk?
slides.notes: Pose the question; let it sit.

text: A line in the accent color.
slides.notes: Deliver the contrast. accentLineIdx colors that line in the accent.
A single hero word as a hard beat.

slides.text: The step, stated as an action.
slides.notes: Say step one. (Big faint number is decorative.)
Walk the pipeline; final node is highlighted.
Three parallel points; each gets an accent bar.
Land the close and thank the room.
